The remaining correction 1 awake wall estimate is 571.603 seconds. Correction 2 is 256.646 seconds and saved reconstruction 745.260 seconds, outside that suspension.

At 17:55:39 UTC Gujrat active PID 7304 had 4690.625 CPU seconds over 4748.367 awake wall seconds, 98.784%. Its short current delta was 5.453125 CPU seconds over 5.540947 wall seconds. These are scheduled computation, not explained by suspension or scheduler starvation alone.

Earlier audit found 12 simultaneous GPR workers plus unrelated Abaqus. The later three sampled GPR workers each had one running thread and 46 waiting threads. Separate 24-thread BLAS pools do not establish active BLAS oversubscription.
No historic .prof/.pstats artifact was found. Root then supplied a nonblocking 10-second stack sample, aggregated above; full-run function timing and cold/warm cache counters remain unavailable.
code_findings: retrack_processed computes orders but calls _run without that scope. _run passes the complete radar, all layer_specs and full seed context to fit_processed. Only merge_local_paths restricts output replacement.
Opening a saved project executes initial _run and one full retrack per saved correction; v3 has three full fits during reconstruction.
hybrid builds both deep correspondence graphs anew. Candidate/table/template/admissibility/seed-barrier/upper-path dependencies mean a whole graph keyed only by acquisition is unsafe to reuse.
Scalar reciprocal DTW has a 4096-entry exact waveform-bytes+band LRU. Per-call dtw_cache is discarded after each graph. The batch branch bypasses the global scalar cache and recalculates alignments.
The 96 MiB numerical feature cache already stores seed-independent wavelet ridges and adjacent local motion. Composed motion and contextual waveforms are still recomputed inside correspondence_graph.

bounded_reuse_candidate.primitive: reciprocal waveform DTW result, before seed-specific link admission and graph inference
bounded_reuse_candidate.identity_contract: Key exact input waveform bytes, dtype/shape, band, direction/reciprocal convention and algorithm version; include scalar-vs-batch implementation unless byte equivalence is established. Preserve float64 arithmetic, diagonal/up/left tie priority, reciprocal centre-slip result and no-fastmath semantics.
bounded_reuse_candidate.safe_scope: Reuse the same numerical primitive for exactly the same inputs while rebuilding current seed barriers, admissibility, support, complete paths, margins and acceptance.
bounded_reuse_candidate.not_safe: Reusing a prior candidate table, graph, accepted path or confidence solely because the correction is outside a window; regenerated tables and upper interfaces depend on seeds.
bounded_reuse_candidate.evidence_gap: No hit/miss counters, pair count by batch/scalar branch, or whole-run function CPU timings were recorded; whole-run benefit cannot be quantified from current artifacts.
bounded_reuse_candidate.recommendation: The phase sample now justifies the lead-assigned bounded exact-DTW accelerator experiment. Retain current latency limitations until exact tuple/link/path/signature parity and cold/warm correction timings pass. Preserve ties, invalid/no-path behavior, float64 cost/backtrace and external NumPy exp; no fastmath. Do not assert a whole-run speedup from a short active-phase sample.
